$comment: Ids nobody but the maintainers may list, and prefixes nobody but the maintainers may list under. Three reasons: an id that reads as first-party is an impersonation primitive; the daemon reserves a few names for its own directories; and a panel route name is a word a plugin page could otherwise answer to. Removing an entry here is a security change, not a cleanup — and so is ADDING one to either allowlist below. The predicate that reads them is tools/lib/reserved.mjs, imported by both tools/validate.mjs and bot/lib/derive.mjs, so that what CI refuses in the tree and what the bot refuses at ingest cannot be two different answers.
reserved_note: The third reason, added 2026-09-19, is the one whose cost is paid by authors rather than by us, so it is written down. The panel that replaces this repository's Pages site serves plugin pages under a path, and its own pages — search, sign-in, the transparency log — are pages too. The route scheme keeps them apart on its own: every non-plugin route lives under /plugins/_/, and no id may start with an underscore, so a listing named `search` shadows nothing today. These names are reserved anyway, because the separation is a property of one URL scheme in one codebase and the damage if that scheme is ever relaxed is a stranger's page served where the panel's own is expected. A reserved id is permanent in the only direction that matters: it is a name no author can ever take, and taking one back later is a security change that has to be argued rather than merged. WHICH sixteen, and that each is refused, is asserted in tools/selftest/validation.mjs rather than restated here — a list in prose beside the list it describes is the one that goes stale. astra stays first below; the rest are sorted.
first_party_repos_note: KNICE-TECH/astra-chess is here ONLY so the frozen astra-chess listing, whose source.repo and signed version files still name it, keeps validating. The owner login KNICE-TECH is no longer first-party: the organisation was renamed MINICE-AI on or before 2026-09-12, and GitHub frees a renamed login for anybody to register. The entry grants that one repository name nothing that reaches a user: plugins/astra-chess is unlisted, a release cannot lift unlisted (bot/lib/derive.mjs), and E_TRADEMARK refuses any astra- release from a KNICE-TECH repository (bot/policy/trademarks.json). tools/selftest.mjs fails if any listing under a KNICE-TECH repo pair is not unlisted. Delete the entry when astra-chess moves to MINICE-AI/astra-chess.
first_party_owners_note: Owner logins whose EVERY repository may list under a reserved prefix — present and future, including one a collaborator with push access creates. Wider than first_party_repos by construction, so an entry here is a statement that the project vouches for the whole account. MINICE-AI is the organisation named KNICE-TECH until its rename; KNICE is Astra team (publishers/KnlCE.json) and astra-chess is his. The old login is deliberately NOT here: a renamed login is free for anybody to register, so trusting it would hand every astra- id to whoever registers it first.
